Maya Chen: Vega Systems invoiced us for $12,450 but their PDF has no PO number. Vendor says late fee if not paid EOM.
Liam Ortiz: Whats the invoice id?
Maya Chen: `VS-2026-0389`. Vendor ref `99823`. Charges for dedicated GPU hours + storage + cross-region egress.
Antonio Rivera: That looks like it should map to PO-7782 (EngPlatform). Vendor probably used an old PO from last year.
Priya Sinha: Coupa search: PO-5498 is archived, PO-7782 active. Invoice doesn't reference PO-7782 so auto-match failed.
FinanceBot: ALERT: Invoice VS-2026-0389 flagged - NO_PO_MATCH. Status: PAYMENT_HOLD.
Maya Chen: Theyre pushing for payment and offered to do a bank transfer if ACH fails. Asking for one-off exception.
Antonio Rivera: One-off exception requires VP approval + AP ticket. Also need cost center and GL mapping.
Priya Sinha: @Ava Li can you confirm cost center and manager approval so we can route?
Maya Chen: Uploaded vendor email thread and invoice screenshot. Suggested GL 6002 / subacct 42 in AP notes.
Ava Li: Confirmed EngPlatform cost center 220-EP. I approve a single-payment exception pending FP&A sign-off.
Liam Ortiz: Best path: ask vendor to reissue invoice with PO-7782. If they can't, AP ticket to bypass PO-match with approvals.
FinanceBot: AP ticket created: AP-54231. Approvers required: Ava Li, Josef R. Approve within 48h to avoid vendor late fee.
Priya Sinha: Kicking off approvals now. @Josef R please review FP&A impact.
Josef R: Reviewed cash plan and GL; approve one-time override. Add note: "vendor billed wrong PO; reissue requested." Will sign.
FinanceBot: Required approvals received. PAYMENT_HOLD cleared. Payment scheduled for next payment run: 2026-03-30.
Maya Chen: I'll confirm with Vega that payment is scheduled and insist future invoices reference PO-7782. :thumbsup:
Liam Ortiz: Thanks. Priya, please mark AP-54231 resolved after payment posts.
Priya Sinha: Will follow up and close the ticket after payment confirmation and vendor reissue check.
